title: ContentUserSubscription - Data API
description: Represents a subscription for a user following another user. This object is available in API version 42.0 and later.

SubscribedToUserId.description: ID of the user who is followed by another user. This is a relationship field.

SubscriberUserId.description: ID of the user who follows another user. This is a relationship field.

special_access_rules:
Only users with Modify All Data permission have access to this object.

<complexType name="ContentUserSubscription">
  <complexContent>
    <extension base="ens:sObject">
      <sequence>
        <element name="SubscribedToUser" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User"/>
        <element name="SubscribedToUserId" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="SubscriberUser" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User"/>
        <element name="SubscriberUserId" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
      </sequence>
    </extension>
  </complexContent>
</complexType>
<simpleType name="ID">
